title: Print Abbreviation Mechanism
description: Add a proper abbreviation-list mechanism (Abkürzungsverzeichnis) to the print LaTeX stack, generalizing the existing glossary machinery (GlossaryDefine/Gls/listofglossaries in print/tex/semio-window.sty, semio-table.sty, semio-core.sty) into a shared term-list factory instantiated for both glossary and abbreviations. Remove the dead/colliding `abbreviations` window-kind (box type, never used, squats on \listofabbreviations name). Wire it into mit-bestand/bericht/zwischenbericht/zwischenbericht.tex (and its -dark sibling) in the appendix directly after \listofglossaries, with entries for LLM, KI, AP, HID, REST, NGS, KET, BBSR (German, no-technical-background definitions), and \Abbr{} wired at each term's first occurrence in the body so page references populate.
summary: Added an Abkürzungsverzeichnis (list of abbreviations) mechanism to the print LaTeX stack, generalizing the existing glossary machinery into a shared expl3 term-list factory instantiated for both `glossary` and `abbreviations` (public macros: GlossaryDefine/Gls/listofglossaries unchanged in behavior; new AbbreviationDefine/Abbr/listofabbreviations). Removed the dead, colliding `abbreviations` window-kind (an unused callout-box type that also squatted on the `\listofabbreviations` name) and its i18n registrations. Added German/English title and header strings for the new list. Wired it into the Zwischenbericht appendix directly after the glossary, with 8 entries (AP, KI, LLM, HID, REST, NGS, KET, BBSR) written for a non-technical reader, and `\Abbr{}` calls at each term's first body occurrence so the Pages column resolves to real, deduplicated, hyperlinked page numbers — verified via a standalone tectonic build+PNG render fixture and a full production build of both zwischenbericht.tex and its -dark sibling (already kept in sync by the repo's live mirroring). Fixed several expl3 bugs discovered along the way while generalizing the storage/label-tracking pipeline (unscoped catcode leak, wrong argument order in an exp_args call, and a hash-doubling typo) — all confined to the new/refactored code path, glossary rendering re-verified as a regression check.
